Agent Name: Orchestrator  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator made an error by providing ambiguous instructions regarding the specific details needed to differentiate "items marked as dehydrated" and "items in the Frozen/Chilled section that contain the whole name of the item, but not if they're marked Chilled." The instruction failed to clearly define the data classification criteria, leading subsequent steps to overlook specific comparisons between entire lists of standards in the 1959 and 2023 databases. This lack of clarity resulted in errors in identifying relevant standards, miscounting superseded standards, and ultimately providing an incorrect final percentage. The Orchestrator should have clearly outlined criteria related to item classification and documented updates in USDA databases explicitly. This failure cascaded into incomplete and potentially inaccurate calculations later in the conversation.
